gloss: shortness of breath; being out of breath

definitions.gloss: shortness of breath, being out of breath
definitions.explanation: Difficulty breathing or catching one's breath, often occurring during physical exertion or as a symptom of illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧⟦と→と：noentry⟧{息切|いきぎ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I get out of breath when I climb stairs.

examples.japanese: {息切|いきぎ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's take a break if the shortness of breath gets worse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動悸|どうき}→動悸：06299_douki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{息切|いきぎ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Palpitations and shortness of breath are the main symptoms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{息切|いきぎ}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I get out of breath from just walking a little.

notes:
MEDICAL/HEALTH TERM:
{息切|いきぎ}れ describes difficulty breathing or feeling out of breath, and can be a normal response to exertion or a symptom of medical conditions.

NORMAL CAUSES:
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: Physical exercise
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧: Climbing stairs
- ⟦{高地|こうち}→高地：29340_kouchi⟧: High altitude
- ⟦{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧: Lack of exercise

MEDICAL CAUSES:
- ⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧: Anemia
- ⟦{心臓病|しんぞうびょう}→心臓病：04418_shinzoubyou⟧: Heart disease
- ⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧: Lung disease
- ⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧: Asthma

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {息切|いきぎ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be out of breath
- {息切|いきぎ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: to have severe shortness of breath
- {息切|いきぎ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to develop shortness of breath

WHEN TO SEE A DOCTOR:
If {息切|いきぎ}れ occurs at rest or with minimal activity, or is accompanied by ⟦{胸痛|きょうつう}→胸痛：29529_kyoutsuu⟧ (chest pain) or ⟦{動悸|どうき}→動悸：06299_douki⟧ (palpitations), seek medical attention.
